title: Automated True-Up and Uplift Fairness Framework for Multi-Year Renewals
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: Enterprise customers with annual commits and multi-year discounts currently undergo manual true-up calculations at renewal. This creates friction, inconsistent uplift application, surprise overage bills, and downstream disputes with account teams. Goal: build an automated, auditable true-up + uplift framework that (1) applies multi-year discounts deterministically, (2) provides a capped and transparent overage fairness rule set, and (3) exposes a self-serve reconciliation UI for finance and customer reps. The outcome should reduce billing disputes by 70% and speed up renewals by removing manual reconciliation from AEs. Scope: pricing rules engine, billing export changes, UI for reconciliation, legal-approved T&Cs language, and one pilot with 10 strategic customers.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Pricing rules engine applies uplift tiers and multi-year discounts to synthetic billing data with 100% deterministic results across 3 scenarios (baseline, 20% overage, 200% overage). 2) Self-serve reconciliation UI shows line-item true-up, suggested uplift, and final recommended invoice. 3) Legal-approved messaging and opt-in checkbox for uplift automation included in renewal contracts. 4) Pilot with 10 customers executed and NPS on bill clarity +30 vs baseline.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (Nov): Implement rules engine + finance export mapping; Phase 2 (Dec): Build reconciliation UI and audit trail; Phase 3 (Jan): Pilot with 10 customers + iterate; Phase 4 (Mar): Launch to all enterprise customers behind feature flag. Rollout metrics: dispute rate, time-to-accept renewal, revenue recognition accuracy.
finance_model: Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1FinanceModelTrueUp (internal) - contains uplift ladder scenarios, ARR impact models, and sensitivity analysis. Key formula: final_invoice = committed_floor + max(0, billed_usage - committed_floor) * uplift_factor - multi_year_discount. uplift_factor = base_uplift - discount_step where discount_step = multi_year_year_index * step_pct. Cap: uplift_factor <= uplift_cap (default 2.0x) and overage_charge <= 150% of list-rate for standard customers.

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Perceived revenue gouging if uplift appears opaque. Mitigation: publish line-item math in UI and require opt-in for automated uplift. Risk: Legal/regulatory constraint in specific regions. Mitigation: geo-block uplift automation until legal sign-off. Risk: Edge cases where committed_floor is mis-specified. Mitigation: add validation checks and manual override path with audit log.
notes: Trade-offs discussed: conservative uplift caps reduce immediate revenue capture but preserve long-term renewals & reduce churn. We prioritized predictability over maximal uplift for H1 rollout.
